policy_note: No scalar score or total ranking is computed. Hard constraints are non-compensable. Robust dominance requires separation of uncertainty intervals for each objective.

semantics.robust_dominance: For minimize, A.upper <= B.lower; for maximize A.lower >= B.upper on every objective, with strict separation on at least one. Overlap does not establish dominance.
semantics.frontier: Only fully evidenced feasible alternatives can enter the Pareto frontier. Infeasible and Unknown alternatives remain visible in separate lists.

cases.description: One feasible alternative is strictly better on all objectives.
Travel time and affordability trade off; neither option dominates.
A high-yield alternative violates an ecological land-take hard constraint.
A low-cost option violates the minimum effective-access service floor.
Identical objective vectors are tied and neither strictly dominates.
One candidate is dominated by a second across all declared objectives.
Overlapping uncertainty intervals do not establish robust dominance.
Separated uncertainty intervals establish robust dominance.
A missing required objective value leaves the alternative Unknown.
Stale cost evidence cannot establish a dominance claim.
Metric unit mismatch makes the entire comparison Unsupported.
Alternative scope digest mismatch makes the comparison Unsupported.
Good mean access cannot compensate for failing a worst-served group hard floor.
An average-access gain trades off against worse worst-decile access.
Excellent objective values cannot compensate for a known carbon constraint violation.
Zero-width uncertainty intervals behave like exact values.
Input ordering does not affect the normalized Pareto result.
Weak no-worse dimensions plus one strict improvement establish dominance.
An Unknown alternative cannot dominate a fully evidenced alternative.
All feasible alternatives with cross-cutting trade-offs remain on the Pareto frontier.
Known infeasible alternatives remain visible but are excluded from the frontier.
Duplicate alternative IDs make the comparison Unsupported.
A missing objective definition digest makes the comparison Unsupported.
Inverted uncertainty bounds make the comparison Unsupported.
